title: チェック・状態のアイコン
lead: チェックマーク・丸・バツ・警告・ピン・しおりなど、資料やWebで状態を示すアイコン12点です。チェックリストや比較表に使えます。
subject_en: Simple status icons, each ONE bold symbol on its own round or square badge, centred, flat colours, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a thick green check mark on a round badge
a rounded square box with a blue check mark inside
a bold red circle mark (maru) on a white badge
a bold grey cross mark on a round badge
a yellow warning triangle with an exclamation dot symbol (no letters)
a blue round badge with a lowercase-i shaped symbol made of shapes only
a thumbs-up hand on a round badge
a red flag on a short pole
an archery target with an arrow in the centre
